materials_exhausted.note: All local material relevant to the original owner-worker blockers was opened. Remaining uncertainties are preserved as cautions, not fabricated values.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered the local source-supported antiviral IC50 matrix from Fig. 1g and Supplementary Figs. S1-S5, added qualitative cytotoxicity evidence from Supplementary Fig. S4, preserved DRAMP sequence/modification/name conflicts in the database layer, and replaced the generic mechanism placeholder with source-backed antiviral fusion-inhibition mechanism evidence. The paper is publication-grade only with cautions; it is not an antibacterial MIC/MBC source.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Citation links are source_verified for DOI/PMID/title traceability. Activity/experiment rows are matched to local figure-supported values but remain sequence_modified_not_normalized because DRAMP normalized sequences do not carry source-declared linker/lipid modifications and IPB02V names conflict with DRAMP IBP02V spellings.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: 110 source-supported rows were extracted from local figures and captions. Antiviral IC50 rows use nM direct normalization; cytotoxicity is recorded qualitatively because exact S4 bar heights are not tabulated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is adjudicated as antiviral coronavirus fusion inhibition supported by DSP fusion/PV assays and HR1P biophysical interaction data. No antibacterial AMP mechanism is inferred.

caution_findings.evidence_context: 72 linked DRAMP activity/experiment rows have source-supported activity values but remain sequence_modified_not_normalized because database sequences omit source linker/lipid modifications and linked_sequence_records are absent.
Primary figures use IPB02V1-IPB02V5; DRAMP rows spell these as IBP02V1-IBP02V5. Conflict preserved in database audit.
Supplementary Fig. S4 supports no obvious cytotoxicity at 10 uM for IPB02 derivatives in 293T/ACE2 and Huh-7 cells, but exact bar heights were not locally tabulated.
